Definition: of uncertain derivation; Paphus, a place in Cyprus:--Paphos.
BiblicalUsage: Paphos is the city on the west coast of Cyprus where Paul and Barnabas meet Elymas the sorcerer and the deputy Sergius Paulus. From Paphos they sail on to Perga in Pamphylia.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paphos is where the gospel first meets a Roman ruler face to face: a sorcerer is struck blind, a deputy believes, and the word goes on.
